part.text:
The images are ready. ✅

**`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the workspace defines exactly one view (`SystemContext`), so there's one image.

A note on how it was produced: this environment has no Java/PlantUML, no Node, and no external network access (the PlantUML server is unreachable), so I couldn't run a standard renderer. Instead I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the Structurizr tooling and generated the SVG directly from that definition, matching the C4 style:

- **Patron** (person, teal) → **Library** (system, blue), left-to-right layout
- Relationship labeled *"Browses the catalogue through"* with *(HTTPS)*
- Title "System Context View: Library" and a C4 legend, per the view's `SHOW_LEGEND` setting

The SVG is well-formed (all tags balanced) and opens in any browser or image viewer. If you'd prefer PNG, it can be converted with any standard tool (e.g. `rsvg-convert` or a browser screenshot) — just let me know.
